desc:
⭐ WHAT IS SUPERSTAR RACERS?
Superstar Racers is a fast paced multiplayer racing game mixed with modern 3D platformer elements. Have fun and challenge your friends by racing in different unique maps! Remember, momentum is KEY to beating stages as fast as possible!

🎮 CONTROLS:
[Space/A]: Star Spin
[E/RT - Moving]: Star Dive
[E/RT - Grounded]: Peelout
[E - After Bonk]: Wall Kick
[Q/LT]: Taunt
[R/Y]: Quick Reset
[RMouse]: Lock Cursor
